advancedArguments.name: previousShiftDetails
advancedArguments.description: Details of previously assigned shifts. Retrieved from the 'getShiftAdjustmentDetails' API. Only non-pending shifts can be updated. Pending shifts are displayed for reference. For each shift, store the abbreviation and corresponding code.

raw.description: Details of previously assigned shifts. Retrieved from the 'getShiftAdjustmentDetails' API. Only non-pending shifts can be updated. Pending shifts are displayed for reference. For each shift, store the abbreviation and corresponding code.

preShiftCode.description: Unique code representing the existing shift.

date.description: The roster date on which the user wants to update the shift. Example: '2025-09-02T00:00:00'.

advancedArguments.name: updateShiftDetails
advancedArguments.description: New or updated shift details assigned to replace or update existing shifts. This is derived using scheduling modes. Each item maps a new abbreviation and its corresponding code.

raw.description: New or updated shift details assigned to replace or update existing shifts. This is derived using scheduling modes. Each item maps a new abbreviation and its corresponding code.

newShiftAbbreviation.description: Abbreviation of the new shift to be assigned.

newShiftCode.description: Unique code representing the new shift.
